summary: Phases 3, 5, 6 of Fines module fully validated. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests PASS (Phase 5 OCR including real Gemini Vision call, Phase 6 CSV/Excel/PDF exports, Phase 3 documents upload/download/delete + stats/extended + RBAC). Frontend: FinesDashboardPage renders KPIs, 3 charts, 3 Top-10 tables. FinesWidget visible for admin (Total/Ouvert/À payer) and hidden for driver (silently returns null on 403). FineFormDialog has 6 typed upload buttons in EDIT mode only — CREATE mode correctly hides Documents section. Driver access to /livre/amendes/dashboard is redirected to /livre/dashboard.

issues: Date inputs (Date réception, Date d'infraction, Échéance, Payée le) use the browser-default <input type='date'/datetime-local> picker (mm/dd/yyyy in en-US locale) instead of a shadcn Calendar component. Cosmetic; affects locale consistency. Already a known pattern across the app, not introduced by this iteration.

Brief Recharts console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount before ResponsiveContainer measures. Charts render correctly after first frame. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: fines.py route file is now 865 lines — at the limit of the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into fines_crud.py / fines_documents.py / fines_export.py / fines_stats.py for future maintainability. Not blocking.

fines.py:859 _months_delta uses timedelta(days=30*n) — drifts by ~6 days/year. For the 12-month evolution chart this is acceptable since labels are computed alongside via .replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=30*i), and the result is bucketed by 'YYYY-MM' from the same arithmetic. However, if month boundaries near calendar edges (Feb/Mar) ever matter, switch to dateutil.relativedelta or calendar.monthrange.

fines.py:778 overdue date parse: the `.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc if 'T' not in str(d) else None)` expression is confusing and only correct because fromisoformat() of a 'Z'-suffixed string already yields tz-aware UTC. Suggest simplification to: parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(d).replace('Z', '+00:00')); if parsed.tzinfo is None: parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).

ocr_extract endpoint correctly audits with action='ocr_extract' and actor=email. Model name hard-coded as 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' in response — matches spec; if the ocr_engine ever switches model this string needs to be a single source of truth (currently fine).

DOCUMENT_MIME_WHITELIST includes 'image/heic' / 'image/heif' — note that browsers' file inputs typically send 'image/heic' but iOS Safari can send empty content_type; document upload would 400 in that edge case. Not in scope to fix, but worth noting for mobile UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids verified, RBAC enforced, dashboard renders end-to-end)
